#!/bin/sh
# cezar managed install — do not edit; `cez install` regenerates this file.
CEZ_MANAGED_HOME='/srv/cockpit'
CEZ_VERSIONS="$CEZ_MANAGED_HOME/versions"
ENTRY="$CEZ_VERSIONS/current/node_modules/@wjarka/cezarion/dist/index.js"

# `cezar use <id>` flips the active version without starting cezar — works even when the
# active version has no idea what a managed install is.
if [ "$1" = "use" ] && [ -n "$2" ]; then
  if [ ! -f "$CEZ_VERSIONS/$2/node_modules/@wjarka/cezarion/dist/index.js" ]; then
    echo "cezar: version '$2' is not installed under $CEZ_VERSIONS" >&2
    echo "installed:" >&2
    ls -1 "$CEZ_VERSIONS" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^current$' | grep -v '^\.' | sed 's/^/  /' >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  # `ln -sfn` replaces the link itself; a `mv` onto a symlink-to-directory would move INTO it.
  ln -sfn "$2" "$CEZ_VERSIONS/current" || exit 1
  echo "cezar: now using $2"
  exit 0
fi

if [ ! -f "$ENTRY" ]; then
  echo "cezar: no active version under $CEZ_VERSIONS — run: npx @wjarka/cezarion install" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "cezar: node is not on PATH (Node 20+ is required)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
exec node "$ENTRY" "$@"
